summary: Accelevation Holdings Corp. reported that subsidiary Accelevation LLC entered a new senior secured credit agreement on October 9, 2026, with Bank of America as administrative and collateral agent. The facility comprises a $250.0 million term loan and $400.0 million revolver, with $150.0 million drawn at closing. Proceeds, plus cash, repaid the existing credit agreement. Obligations are guaranteed by Holdings and domestic subsidiaries and secured by substantially all assets. Covenants include a 4.00x net leverage cap from Q1 2027, stepping to 4.50x after large acquisitions. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
